start_here: Say to your AI: "Run tool:keep-tool-copies-in-step with op plan and repo, my project's repository address." It says, for every tool folder the project copied in, whether upstream moved, you edited it, both, or neither; then run it with op apply and plan's answer, and each upstream change waits on its own sync/upstream branch for you to review and merge.
no_lists_because: This tool reads the project from a clone it keeps in its own kept folder and pushes only sync/upstream branches to the project's repository; it reads and keeps no list rows.
instructions: 1. Ask your AI to run tool:keep-tool-copies-in-step with {"op":"plan","repo":"<your project's repository address>"}. It fetches the project's main into its own clone; read each tool's state and its files' verdicts. Nothing is pushed.

2. Run it with {"op":"apply","repo":"<the same address>","plan":<plan's answer>}. Read waiting (each upstream change on its branch sync/upstream/<tool>/<upstream commit>, created when this run made it, would_open while no GitHub key is held), project_only (your edits, which stay where they are), conflicts (each with its diff: settle those by hand), forked and refused.
3. Review and merge each sync/upstream branch yourself, as any change; the tool never merges, never moves main and pushes no other ref.
